content: KDE/COSMIC session autologin + runtime checks (2026-10-24; harness kde 74/74 + cosmic 74/74): autologin generalized to all four DEs — kde via sddm [Autologin] drop-in (/etc/sddm.conf.d/zz-feralos-test-autologin.conf, Session=plasma, wayland; shell appended to /etc/shells for sddm-autologin pam_shells), cosmic via greetd [initial_session] (start-cosmic) in /etc/greetd/feralos-cosmic-greeter.toml. Product fixes (aports bd4db35, CI 40140550886): cosmic-greeter-dinit ran the greeter frontend directly (cosmic-greeter 1.0 is a greetd frontend needing GREETD_SOCK) -> now runs greetd with /etc/greetd/feralos-cosmic-greeter.toml (VT 7, base-only /etc/pam.d/cosmic-greeter override — Alpine's requires pam_gnome_keyring), wrapper ensures the greeter user + runtime dirs, cosmic-greeter-daemon unit added, pam-rundir dep. cosmic user needs the seat group (seatd socket root:seat 0770 — libseat EACCES, debug_run-proven by intervention). Harness checks kde_session/cosmic_session (compositor+shell+wayland socket) use anchored pgrep -f (busybox pgrep -x false-negative: run 23-06-35Z proved processes RUNNING while pgrep -x polled 90s). Validated: kde 2026-10-24T23-35-39Z 74/74 (kwin_wayland+plasmashell), cosmic 23-50-51Z 74/74 (cosmic-comp+cosmic-session, wayland-1). Remaining: KDE/cosmic session-bus ADR-010 coverage (own session bus, no user-dinit stack).
